meta.title: "Add missing members" quick fixes incorrectly add TypeScript types in JavaScript files
meta.fix_ref: microsoft/TypeScript#51922 (fix(51920): skip TypeScript types in js files), 645b3ddb06, 2022-12-16; git tag --contains: first in v5.0-beta / v5.0.2
meta.build_notes: npm typescript@4.9.5 (2023-01-30) and typescript@5.0.2 (2023-03-16), both behind typescript-language-server@3.3.0 (the latest wrapper release before 5.0.2), started with the pinned tsserver.js; the reported TypeScript version is checked on every session. 4.9.5 is on the 4.9 branch and does not contain the fix.
meta.notes: The first example of the issue (add missing properties on a JSDoc-typed object); the decorator example is not used. Type annotations in a .js file are reported by tsserver as errors (TS8010), not as parse errors of the syntax classifier, hence edit_leaves_diagnostic.

settings_note: The issue names no settings; the file has // @ts-check; no jsconfig.json, so tsserver uses an inferred project.

files.source: issue body, first js code block ('In a JavaScript file')
files.note: the file name is not given in the issue

repro.steps: Open index.js: 'export const obj = {}' is reported (TS2741, property f missing for the @type of obj). Trigger the quick fix 'Add missing properties' on obj. Reported: the generated function uses TypeScript type annotations ('function (x: string): number'), which are errors in a JavaScript file. Probe: after the fix, a fresh session on the edited file must neither report the targeted TS2741 nor a new error.
